cli_result.result:
Validation passed with exit status 0.

## Definition check

The **Reproducibility** section is present in my instructions and reads as expected of the current rules. The sentence beginning "Repeatability must be", quoted verbatim and in full:

> Repeatability must be measured on unchanged records under the same evaluator model and definition, because even a fixed or zero sampling temperature does not guarantee identical semantic judgements.

## Evaluation complete

`output_evaluation.json` written and validated (`VALID output_evaluation.json: rubric20-semantic`, exit 0).

**Score: 79/88 — 89.8%** on both bases (no question met an exclusion condition, so `max_points` 88 and `adjusted_max_points` 88 coincide; `excluded_max_points` 0, `questions_not_applicable` 0).

| Category | Score |
|---|---|
| Structural Completeness | 18/21 |
| Metadata Quality & Content | 19/21 |
| Technical Documentation | 22/25 |
| FAIRness & Accessibility | 20/21 |

**Applicability decisions.** All four trigger conditions were resolved before scoring, each from fields belonging to *other* questions per the anti-circular rule. The sharing and software-output conditions were met outright (public Dataverse page, CC BY-NC-SA reuse, `external_resources` code repositories). Q8/Q15 were borderline: the record declares `involves_human_subjects: false`, but `raw_data_sources` — a Q12 field — carries patient-origin donor descriptors for both lines. Per the ambiguity rule I set both `applicable: true` and scored them rather than letting the record's own Q8 fields exclude them.

**Where semantic analysis changed the score.** 22 consistency checks passed, 2 failed, 8 warnings. The failures (confidentiality_level "unrestricted" beside a commercial prohibition and partial embargo; a version-number inversion where the current release is 2.0 and superseded ones are 2.1) are presentational and cost fractions, not bands. What actually held scores down was placement and coverage: Q4→3 because only `application/zip` is declared at the distribution layer; Q7→4 and Q13→4 because affiliations, sizes, governance contacts and publisher sit in prose while their designated fields sit empty; Q11→4 because every preprocessing entry is self-caveated as MuSIC-pipeline work *not applied to the released archives*; Q20→4 for missing measurement/technical bias in a dataset whose assay-level effects propagate straight into trained models.

All identifier validations passed on format *and* plausibility — the DOI prefix matches its stated repository, the NIH activity-code/institute pairings match the roles assigned to each award, and the RRIDs correctly use the Cellosaurus `CVCL_` namespace rather than `SCR_`/`AB_`.

Two caveats on provenance. `shasum` was denied in this session, so the three hashes are recorded as supplied by the launcher rather than independently recomputed; I noted this in `metadata.hash_note`. I also could not locate the agent definition on disk to verify the digest myself — the definition check above rests on the instructions I was given, which do contain the Reproducibility section intact. No other evaluation was read.
